title: One Model Family, Two Gold-Level Results: Fine-Tuning Nemotron for IOI and IMO
summary: This work describes fine-tuning NVIDIA's Nemotron model family to achieve gold-medal-level performance on competitive programming (IOI) and mathematical olympiad (IMO) benchmarks. It details the training methodology, data curation, and optimization techniques used to adapt a single model family to two distinct reasoning-heavy domains, demonstrating strong transfer and specialization capabilities.
